_about: Illustrative guidance, not workshop advice. Red lights generally mean stop; amber lights mean check soon. A light the driver describes is a report, not a diagnosis. 'safety_instruction' is the only advice the agent may give on its own; anything that clears the driver to keep driving needs an operator yes, and the car owner (the customer) decides recovery.

lights.name: Check-engine light, flashing
lights.safety_instruction: Slow down, leave the motorway at the next safe place or hard shoulder, stop and switch the engine off. Do not drive on.
lights.note: Usually a severe misfire. Driving on can overheat the catalytic converter.

lights.name: Check-engine light, steady
lights.safety_instruction: Keep driving gently to the next safe stop and tell us what else you notice. Do not push the car.
lights.who_decides_next: Operator decides whether the driver continues
lights.note: Read the stored codes before deciding.

lights.name: Oil pressure (red oil can)
lights.safety_instruction: Stop as soon as it is safe and switch the engine off. Do not restart it.
lights.note: Driving on can seize the engine within minutes.

lights.name: Coolant temperature (red thermometer)
lights.safety_instruction: Stop as soon as it is safe and switch the engine off. Do not open the coolant cap.

lights.name: Brake system (red circle with !)
lights.safety_instruction: Check the parking brake is fully released. If the light stays on, slow down carefully, stop in a safe place and do not drive on.

lights.name: Battery / charging (red battery)
lights.safety_instruction: Switch off non-essential electrics and leave the motorway at the next safe place. The car may stall.

lights.name: Tyre pressure (amber horseshoe with !)
lights.safety_instruction: Slow down and stop at the next safe place to look at the tyres. Do not drive on a visibly flat tyre.

lights.name: ABS (amber)
lights.safety_instruction: Normal braking still works. Keep extra distance and avoid hard braking until an operator has looked at it.
lights.who_decides_next: Operator decides whether the driver continues
lights.note: If the red brake light is also on, treat it as brake_system.

lights.name: Airbag / SRS
lights.safety_instruction: The car drives normally, but airbags may not work. Tell us before driving on.

lights.name: Power steering
lights.safety_instruction: Steering may become heavy. Slow down and leave the motorway at the next safe place.

lights.name: Gearbox temperature or fault
lights.safety_instruction: Leave the motorway at the next safe place and let the gearbox cool with the engine off.

lights.name: Reduced power / limp mode message
lights.safety_instruction: Turn on the hazard lights if you are slow in fast traffic and leave the motorway at the next safe place.
lights.note: A car in reduced power on a motorway is a safety risk in itself.

lights.name: High-voltage system fault (EV or hybrid)
lights.safety_instruction: Stop as soon as it is safe and switch the car off. Do not touch orange cables. If you see smoke or smell burning, get out and stay well away from the car.

lights.name: Glow plug / engine management (diesel), flashing
lights.safety_instruction: Leave the motorway at the next safe place.
